subtopics.title: Identification of three-dimensional shapes
teacher_activities: Guides students to identify cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones, spheres and pyramids from real-life objects
Leads students to distinguish between plane (2D) and solid (3D) shapes
student_activities: Identify and name common 3D shapes from real-life objects
teaching_learning_materials: Models of 3D shapes, real-life objects (boxes, cans, balls, funnels)
evaluation_guide: Identify and name given three-dimensional shapes

subtopics.title: Basic properties of cubes and cuboids.
performance_objectives: Identify the properties of cubes and cuboids
teacher_activities: Leads students to discover the properties of cubes and cuboids: Cubes: equal faces, 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices; Cuboids: equal opposite faces, 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices
student_activities: Identify the number of faces, edges and vertices of cubes and cuboids, and that cubes have equal faces while opposite faces of a cuboid are equal
teaching_learning_materials: Cubes, Cuboids, Ruler, Tapes, Empty carton, Bricks etc.
evaluation_guide: Identify the number of faces and vertices of a given cube
Identify the number of edges and faces of a cuboid

subtopics.title: Basic properties of pyramids and cones.
performance_objectives: Identify the properties of pyramids and cones
teacher_activities: Guides students to determine the edges, faces and vertices of pyramids and cones
student_activities: Determine the number of edges, faces and vertices of pyramids and cones
evaluation_guide: Identify the number of faces, edges and vertices of a given pyramid and cone

subtopics.title: Basic properties of cylinders and spheres.
performance_objectives: Identify the properties of cylinders and spheres
teacher_activities: Guides students to discover the properties of cylinders and spheres
student_activities: Identify the properties of cylinders and spheres
evaluation_guide: Identify the properties of a given cylinder and sphere

subtopics.title: Volume of cubes and cuboids
performance_objectives: Find volume of a cube and a cuboid
teacher_activities: Leads students to derive the formula for finding the volume of a cube and a cuboid
Guides students to use the formula to calculate the volume of a cube and a cuboid
student_activities: Derive the formula for finding the volume of a cube and a cuboid
Use the formula to calculate the volume of a cube and a cuboid
evaluation_guide: Find volume of a given cube and cuboid
